sentences.text:
Manoranjan Mohapatra vs District And Sessions Judge on 14
May, 2024
Bench: B.R. Sarangi, G. Satapathy

In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 W.P.(C) No. 11939 of 2024
Manoranjan Mohapatra ..... Petition

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. B. Lenka, Advocate
 Vs.
District and Sessions Judge, Khordha .....

Opposite Parti
and others
 Mr .P.K. Muduli, Aga
 Coram:
 Dr. Justice B.R. Sarangi
 Mr. Justice G. Satapathy
 Order
This matter is taken up by hybrid mode.

As it appears, the matter has been referred under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 to the appropriate Civil Court, which is pending.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In the meantime, the LAR & R Court has been constituted and this Court, vide order letter dated 07.11.2019, directed to all the District and Sessions Judges to transfer those cases to LAR & R Authorities.
It is stated that the same has not yet been transferred to the LAR & R Authorities.

When this Court made a query to learned counsel for the Petitioner that as to whether the Petitioner has filed any application before the Civil Court for transfer of the case to the LAR & R Authorities in compliance of the order communication made by this Court, it is stated that the same has not been filed till date.

3. In course of hearing, learned counsel appearing for the Petitioner that the Petitioner may be permitted to withdraw the writ petition with liberty to pursue his remedy before the appropriate forum in accordance with law.
4. In view of the above submission, the writ petition stands disposed of as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
(DR. B.R. SARANGI) JUDGE (G. SATAPATHY) JUDGE Priyajit
